topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I found my old teddy bear, the one I thought was lost forever. It's sitting here on my lap, the same soft, slightly worn fabric, the glass eyes still as piercing as I remember. I don't know how it ended up at a yard sale, or how I even recognized it among all those other items. It's like a piece of my childhood is back, but it makes me wonder about everything that's happened since. I keep checking the tag, the faded edges, as if I'm looking for more clues, more answers. Maybe I should have asked who owned it, if they knew its story. Now, I just hold it tightly, feeling like I need to protect it again.
